name: photoreason-skills
description: Photo Reason's open-source skills for photographers: portfolio building, curation, and creative workflows.
skillInstructions: Photo Reason skills are conversational, plain-language guides — many are written for people with no technical background. When a skill says to ask the user, ask clarifying questions, present options, or wait for a choice, use Kimi Code's `AskUserQuestion` tool with 2-4 concrete options (recommended option first, suffixed `(Recommended)`). Use `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Grep`, `Glob`, `FetchURL`, and `WebSearch` by their exposed names. When a skill refers to the `Skill` tool, use Kimi Code's native `Skill` tool.

interface.shortDescription: Portfolio building & creative workflows for photographers
interface.longDescription: Skills that help photographers — including those with no technical background — build portfolio websites, curate and sequence their work, and run creative workflows with coding agents.
